'''Ella''' is a [[serving girl]] at [[The Bunch of Grapes]].

==Activities==
Ella notices that two men, sent by [[Barthanes Damodred]], were looking for [[Thomdril Merrilin]]. She neglected to inform the [[innkeeper]], [[Zera]], until the next day. By that time, it was too late for Thom to prevent the murder of [[Dena]].{{ref/book|2|34}}
